body: The disowned, uncompromising self fuses with core identity, producing the classic strong-willed, independent, freedom-loving, non-conformist temperament. You challenge authority openly and won't be talked out of a decision once made.
business: Magnetic and unstoppable when the cause is yours; built to break rules that deserve breaking.
shadow: Reflexive defiance, burning bridges with anyone in charge, an ego that can't back down.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
